score_notes.F: Two of the 15 sampled claims are unsupported: steering is described as built on intervention handlers (L15, also L404) although the docs say Python steering handlers are plugins, and the post's own code uses plugins=[handler] at L453; the latencyMs=0 limitation (L956) loses its 'Strands 1.47.0' scope. The generator's own warnings flagged both, and both shipped. L849 'prompt-cache reads and writes are counted' drops the docs' provider scope (Bedrock, Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini). The L486 meta note admits a missing import.
score_notes.T1: There is no install step (no `pip install strands-agents`). Most snippets omit their imports: InterventionHandler/Deny/Proceed (L342), HumanInTheLoop (L688), DockerSandbox/make_shell (L962-984), LLMSteeringHandler (L486 admits this) and HookProvider (L189). `refund` is never defined. Flags, defaults and stop reasons are concrete and correct (limits, per_turn, retry_strategy, on_error).
score_notes.T2: Covers the important topics of the seed pages (agent loop, hooks) and the linked official pages in a sensible order: loop, tools, extension points, then production controls. The extra sections (sandbox, A2A/AG-UI) are sourced.
score_notes.T3: Strong on internals and design reasons: hooks sit outside the middleware chain (L297-306), typed decisions with precedence instead of last-write-wins (L322-326), a fresh stateless inner steering agent (L459), limit checks at iteration boundaries (L836), cooperative cancellation (L857-867). Covers system fit through deployment forms, OTEL spans and A2A, and limitations at L1020-1029. Design advice is marked as the writer's judgment.

top_issues: A generator meta note leaked into the body (L484-486: '참고: 요청하신 LLMSteeringHandler import 줄은 넣지 않았습니다...').
Scope drops the generator itself flagged still shipped: Python steering is described as an intervention handler (L15, L404) when it is a plugin, and latencyMs=0 (L956) loses its Strands 1.47.0 scope.

Shared-agent guidance repeats the human-fixed defects: ConcurrencyException is not tied to invoke_async, there is no warning that sync calls in async handlers block, and history leaking across requests is never mentioned. Snippets also lack imports and an install step, and use `refund` vs `refund_order` inconsistently.
